title: Shedeur Sanders or Deshaun Watson? Browns coach wants early clarity on starting QB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders or Deshaun Watson? Browns coach wants early clarity on starting QB
sources.description: New Browns coach Todd Monken said it's been 'refreshing' to work with Shedeur Sanders, but a healthy Deshaun Watson will also compete to be QB1.
